card.name: Recipe steps before wine or broth
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small linking words (period, Add, in, with) in cooking instructions just before an ingredient like wine or broth is added. Also weakly in text about making steroids or energy.

modes.description: Periods or verbs like add and stir in a braised-dish recipe, right before a liquid ingredient is named.
